subject: English Language & Literature
basis: BCS_English_Final: Lecture 01 (Clause, Sentence — Simple/Complex/Compound, Transformation) ও Conditional

questions.q: Unless you hurry, you ___ the last bus.
questions.e: Unless = If … not; first conditional-এ main clause-এ will + base verb।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: I will lend you the book provided you ___ it within a week.
questions.e: provided (that) conditional clause-এ future অর্থেও present simple বসে।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: Take an umbrella in case it ___.
questions.e: in case (যদি হয় এই আশঙ্কায়)-এর পরে present simple।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: But for your timely help, I ___ in the business.
questions.e: But for (না থাকলে) + অতীত প্রসঙ্গ → would have + pp (অতীতে যা ঘটেনি)।
questions.t: But for = If it had not been for।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: ___ I rich, I would build a hospital for the poor.
questions.e: Inversion: If I were rich = Were I rich (if উহ্য রেখে were আগে)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: ___ you need any help, please call me.
questions.e: Inversion: If you should need = Should you need (ভবিষ্যতের সম্ভাবনা)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: I wish I ___ a bird.
questions.e: বর্তমানের অবাস্তব ইচ্ছা: wish + subject + were/past।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: She wishes she ___ harder for the last exam.
questions.e: অতীতের আক্ষেপ: wish + past perfect।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: If only I ___ his phone number now!
questions.e: If only (আহা যদি) বর্তমানের অবাস্তব ইচ্ছায় past simple।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: If he had taken the medicine yesterday, he ___ better now.
questions.e: Mixed conditional: অতীত শর্ত (had taken), বর্তমান ফল (now) → would + V1।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: Suppose you ___ a lottery, what would you do?
questions.e: Suppose/Supposing + অবাস্তব কল্পনা → past simple, main clause-এ would।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: You can stay here as long as you ___ quiet.
questions.e: as long as (যতক্ষণ) শর্তে present simple।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: Walk carefully lest you ___ fall.
questions.e: lest (পাছে)-এর পরে should + V1; lest নিজেই নেতিবাচক, তাই not বসে না।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)
questions.dup: Semantic Duplicate — ২৬-৪৮ (He ran fast lest he --- miss the train = should): একই নিয়ম

questions.q: Hurry up, otherwise you ___ late.
questions.e: otherwise (নইলে) + ভবিষ্যৎ ফল → will।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'What a lovely view it is!' — This is an—
questions.e: আবেগ/বিস্ময় প্রকাশ — exclamatory।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Who does not love his motherland?' — The assertive form is—
questions.e: Negative rhetorical question → positive assertive (Everybody …)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Never tell a lie.' — The assertive form is—
o: You should never tell a lie.
A lie is never told by you.
questions.e: Imperative-এর উপদেশমূলক assertive রূপে should বসে।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'How beautiful the flower is!' — The assertive form is—
questions.e: How + adjective … ! → very + adjective (assertive)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: Which of the following is an interrogative sentence?
o: Can you lend me your pen?
questions.e: প্রশ্ন করা হলে interrogative।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Is there anyone who can solve it?' — The assertive form is—
o: It cannot be solved by someone.
There is no one who can solve it.
questions.e: Positive rhetorical question → negative assertive।
questions.t: Is there anyone…? = There is no one…
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Please help me.' — This sentence expresses—
questions.e: Please-যুক্ত imperative অনুরোধ বোঝায়।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'I know what he wants.' — This is a—
questions.e: what he wants একটি noun clause, সঙ্গে principal clause I know — complex।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'The man who came yesterday is my uncle.' — This is a—
questions.e: who came yesterday — adjective clause; complex।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'He tried hard but failed.' — This is a—
questions.e: but দিয়ে দুটি স্বাধীন অংশ যুক্ত — compound।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Having finished the work, he went home.' — This is a—
questions.e: একটিমাত্র finite verb (went); Having finished = participle phrase।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Despite his illness, he attended the meeting.' — This is a—
questions.e: Despite + noun phrase; finite verb একটিই — simple।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'He is not only a singer but also a dancer.' — This is a—
questions.e: not only … but also — coordinating correlative; compound।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Hardly had he reached the station when the train left.' — This is a—
questions.e: Hardly … when কালবাচক adverb clause-যুক্ত — complex।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Being ill, she could not attend the class.' — This is a—
questions.e: Being ill = participle phrase; একটি finite verb — simple।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'As soon as he saw the police, he ran away.' — The simple form is—
o: He saw the police and he ran away.
On seeing the police, he ran away.
When he saw the police, he ran away.
He ran away as he saw the police.
questions.e: As soon as … → On/Upon + V-ing (simple)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'He is too weak to walk.' — The complex form is—
o: He is very weak to walk.
He is weak and cannot walk.
He is so weak that he cannot walk.
questions.e: too … to → so … that + subject + cannot/could not।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Work hard or you will fail.' — The complex form is—
o: Unless you work hard, you will not fail.
Work hard and you will fail.
If you do not work hard, you will fail.
questions.e: Imperative + or → If you do not … (complex)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'He confessed his guilt.' — The complex form is—
o: He confessed that he was guilty.
He confessed and he was guilty.
He was guilty so he confessed.
questions.e: noun phrase (his guilt) → noun clause (that he was guilty)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'In spite of being rich, he is unhappy.' — The compound form is—
o: Though he is rich, he is unhappy.
He is rich but he is unhappy.
He is rich so he is unhappy.
questions.e: In spite of → but (compound); Though → complex।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'The boy who is industrious will prosper.' — The simple form is—
o: If the boy is industrious, he will prosper.
The boy is industrious and will prosper.
questions.e: adjective clause → adjective (simple)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Besides being a poet, he is a painter.' — The compound form is—
o: He is a poet who is a painter.
Though he is a poet, he is a painter.
Being a poet, he is a painter.
He is not only a poet but also a painter.
questions.e: Besides + V-ing → not only … but also (compound)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'She was so tired that she could not walk.' — The simple form is—
o: She was too tired to walk.
She was tired and could not walk.
She was very tired to walk.
questions.e: so … that … not → too … to (simple)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'He admitted that he was wrong.' — The simple form is—
o: He admitted and he was wrong.
He was wrong so he admitted.
questions.e: noun clause → noun phrase।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Without hard work, nobody can succeed.' — The complex form is—
o: Nobody can succeed if he does not work hard.
questions.e: Without + noun → If … not (complex)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'No sooner had the bell rung than the students left.' — The simple form is—
o: As soon as the bell rang, the students left.
The bell rang and the students left.
When the bell rang, the students left.
On the ringing of the bell, the students left.
questions.e: No sooner … than → On + noun/V-ing (simple)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'He was poor; still he was honest.' — The complex form is—
o: Though he was poor, he was honest.
In spite of being poor, he was honest.
questions.e: still/yet-যুক্ত বৈপরীত্য → Though/Although (complex)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'I saw a bird with a broken wing.' — The complex form is—
o: I saw a bird and its wing was broken.
I saw a bird whose wing was broken.
Seeing a bird, its wing was broken.
The bird had a broken wing that I saw.
questions.e: with + adjective phrase → whose-clause (adjective clause)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Tell me your address.' — The complex form is—
questions.e: noun (address) → noun clause (where you live)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Whatever he says is true.' — The clause 'Whatever he says' is a/an—
questions.e: বাক্যের subject হিসেবে কাজ করছে — noun clause।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'I wonder whether he will come.' — The clause 'whether he will come' is a/an—
questions.e: wonder-এর object — noun clause।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'This is the house where I was born.' — The clause 'where I was born' is a/an—
questions.e: house (noun)-কে বিশেষিত করছে — adjective clause।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'He came when I was sleeping.' — The clause 'when I was sleeping' is a/an—
questions.e: কখন এসেছিল তা বোঝাচ্ছে — adverb clause of time।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'He worked hard so that he might pass.' — The clause 'so that he might pass' is a/an—
questions.e: উদ্দেশ্য বোঝায় — adverb clause of purpose।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Though he tried hard, he failed.' — The clause 'Though he tried hard' is a/an—
questions.e: বৈপরীত্য/স্বীকার বোঝায় — adverb clause of concession।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'The fact that he lied surprised us.' — The clause 'that he lied' is a/an—
questions.e: the fact-এর সমার্থক ব্যাখ্যা (apposition) — noun clause।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Give me the reason why you are late.' — The clause 'why you are late' is a/an—
questions.e: reason (noun)-কে বিশেষিত করছে — adjective clause।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'He is as tall as his brother is.' — The clause 'as his brother is' is a/an—
questions.e: তুলনা বোঝায় — adverb clause of comparison।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'The pen which you gave me is lost.' — The clause 'which you gave me' is a/an—
questions.e: pen-কে বিশেষিত করছে।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'If you study, you will pass.' — The clause 'you will pass' is a/an—
questions.e: নিজে স্বাধীনভাবে অর্থ প্রকাশ করে — principal clause; If-অংশ adverb clause।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Where there is a will, there is a way.' — The clause 'Where there is a will' is a/an—
questions.e: স্থান/শর্ত বোঝায় — adverb clause।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'That he will come is certain.' — The clause 'That he will come' is a/an—
questions.e: বাক্যের subject — noun clause।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'The man in the black coat is my uncle.' — The phrase 'in the black coat' is a/an—
questions.e: man (noun)-কে বিশেষিত করছে — adjective phrase।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'She sat under the old banyan tree.' — The phrase 'under the old banyan tree' is a/an—
questions.e: কোথায় বসেছিল — verb (sat)-কে বিশেষিত করছে, adverb phrase।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'I love reading detective novels.' — The phrase 'reading detective novels' is a/an—
questions.e: love-এর object — noun phrase (gerund phrase)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'He has been working since morning.' — 'has been working' is a/an—
questions.e: auxiliary + main verb মিলে verb phrase।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'A man of wisdom is respected everywhere.' — The phrase 'of wisdom' is a/an—
questions.e: man-কে বিশেষিত করছে (a wise man) — adjective phrase।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'Alas, what a pity!' — 'what a pity' is a/an—
questions.e: আবেগ প্রকাশক শব্দগুচ্ছ — interjectional phrase।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'In spite of the storm, the ship sailed.' — 'In spite of' is a/an—
questions.e: কয়েকটি শব্দ মিলে preposition-এর কাজ — prepositional phrase (phrase preposition)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: 'He will come as soon as possible.' — 'as soon as' commonly works as a/an—
questions.e: as soon as clause যুক্ত করে — conjunctional phrase (phrase conjunction)।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: A group of words containing a subject and a finite verb is called a—
questions.e: subject + finite verb = clause; finite verb ছাড়া = phrase।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: A group of words that makes sense but has no finite verb is called a—
questions.e: finite verb নেই = phrase।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: A complex sentence contains one principal clause and—
questions.e: complex = ১টি principal + ১ বা একাধিক subordinate clause।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: A compound sentence contains—
o: one independent and one dependent clause
questions.e: compound = দুই বা ততোধিক independent clause।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: Which conjunction introduces a compound sentence?
questions.e: and, but, or, so, yet, for (FANBOYS) coordinating conjunction — compound।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: Which word introduces a complex sentence?
questions.e: because subordinating conjunction — complex।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: The number of clauses in a sentence usually equals the number of its—
questions.e: প্রতিটি clause-এ একটি finite verb থাকে।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: Choose the sentence that is grammatically complete.
o: When the rain stopped, we went out.
questions.e: শুধু subordinate clause বা phrase পূর্ণ বাক্য নয়; principal clause লাগে।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: Identify the correct conditional sentence.
o: If it rains, the match will be postponed.
If it will rain, the match will be postponed.
If it rained, the match will be postponed.
If it rains, the match would have been postponed.
questions.e: first conditional: if + present, main clause will + V1; if-clause-এ will বসে না।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
o: Had I informed earlier, I could helped.
Had I been informed earlier, I could have helped.
If I had been informed earlier, I can help.
Have I been informed earlier, I could help.
questions.e: Inversion-সহ third conditional: Had + subject + pp → could/would have + pp।
questions.t: Had + S + pp → could have + pp।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)
questions.dup: পাস — ১০-১৯, ২৩-৮১, ৩৯-২৬-এ third conditional-এর main clause জিজ্ঞাসিত; এখানে inversion-যুক্ত পূর্ণ বাক্য শনাক্তকরণ (নিকট-সম্পর্কিত, পর্যালোচিত)

questions.q: 'He said that he was ill.' — The clause 'that he was ill' is a/an—
questions.e: said-এর object হিসেবে কাজ করছে — noun clause।
questions.src: Lecture 01 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Swan — Practical English Usage)
